chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: Both energy into damage: All Streams Flow to the Sea at the Sludge Spinner for 9 (Charge already counted), then Water's Edge for 6, total 15. That takes the Spinner from 34 to 19 and leaves me with no Block, so I eat the telegraphed 8 and end at 40/70. With only one enemy and a single 8-damage intent, 8 HP off a 48 pool is cheap, and 15 damage a turn puts the Spinner on a three-turn clock instead of a five-turn one. Both cards apply Hydro, so order between them carries nothing I can see; I led with the bigger hit in case anything unstated keys off the first strike.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: Gyorin Formation alone: 10 Block now plus 6 at the start of next turn, which fully eats the 8 and banks 2 plus the 6 carryover. I turned it down because it deals zero damage while the Spinner is at 34 — it buys a turn of unhurt life but adds a whole turn to the fight, and each extra turn is another 8 coming at me, so pure blocking against a single small attacker just trades my HP later for my HP now at no profit. I also weighed the split, All Streams plus Coral Guard: 9 damage and 5 Block, taking only 3. That's the safe middle, but it pays 6 damage for 5 Block, and at 48/70 against an 8 I don't need to buy that.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: All the defense in the hand and 8 HP of real life. I end the turn at 40/70 with 0 Block, and Gyorin's 6-Block start-of-next-turn rider is gone unless I draw it again. If the Spinner's next telegraph is much larger, or a second body joins, I face it lower and with nothing banked. I also spent the Charge-boosted All Streams into a target I can't kill this turn, so none of that 15 is lethal overkill value — it's purely putting the clock forward.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. If the Spinner had telegraphed something near or above 16-18, or anything that would put me low enough that the next hit threatened me, I'd play Gyorin Formation instead and take the 10-plus-6 to absorb it. A telegraphed defensive or buffing intent — Block gain in particular — would also move me, since blocking nothing is wasted and I'd want the damage in before the Block lands. And a telegraph in the middle band, say 12-14, would push me to the split line, All Streams plus Coral Guard, keeping pressure on while trimming the hit.
